Posts.RecruitPostName: Tencent Cloud- PaaS Senior Site Reliability Engineer(Malaysia)
Posts.Responsibility:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
System Monitoring and Maintenance: Ensure the stability and reliability of Tencent Cloud's PaaS products by continuously monitoring systems, resolving technical issues, and mitigating risks to maintain seamless operations.
Architecture Optimization: Collaborate with the engineering team to optimize and upgrade product architecture, enhancing system performance and scalability through a deep understanding of cloud technologies.
Automation and High-Availability: Implement automated operations and develop high-availability components, focusing on improving system efficiency and conducting high-availability drills.
Tool and Platform Utilization: Utilize CI/CD pipelines, intelligent monitoring systems, and data analytics to enhance operational workflows, reduce costs, and eliminate inefficiencies.

Who We Look For
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related fields.
Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in cloud operations, SRE, or platform engineering roles, preferably supporting large-scale public cloud or enterprise-grade platforms.
Strong understanding of distributed systems with solid practical experience in technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker, Nginx, Redis, Kafka, and MySQL.
Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, including Java, Go, Python, or Shell, with the ability to develop automation and operational tooling.
Strong expertise in Linux systems, TCP/IP networking, and systematic troubleshooting of complex production issues.
Experience with public cloud platforms is required; cloud certifications are a strong plus.
Fluent in both English and Chinese Mandarin, with the ability to collaborate effectively with China-based stakeholders and operate in cross-border technical environments.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Malaysia-Kuala Lumpur
